name: foxtranslate
description: Foxmori 的开源双语翻译扩展，支持网页、文档、YouTube 字幕和生词复习。

scripts.dev: node scripts/restore-assets.mjs && node scripts/gen-icons.mjs && vite build --watch
scripts.build: node scripts/restore-assets.mjs && node scripts/gen-icons.mjs && node scripts/sync-pdfjs-assets.mjs && vite build && vite build -c vite.content.config.ts && vite build -c vite.subtitles.config.ts && vite build -c vite.bridge.config.ts && node scripts/fix-dist.mjs
scripts.build:store: node scripts/restore-assets.mjs && node scripts/gen-icons.mjs && node scripts/sync-pdfjs-assets.mjs && vite build --minify false && vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --minify false && vite build -c vite.subtitles.config.ts --minify false && vite build -c vite.bridge.config.ts --minify false && node scripts/fix-dist.mjs
